data.subject: A small evening reset
data.body: Day 0: If your routine has changed, choose one small step tonight: put the phone away or write down tomorrow. Explore the evening checklist if useful. No discount, urgency claim or health promise. LOCAL DRAFT — NOT SENT.

data.subject: Which ritual fits your week?
data.body: Day 3: A short optional checklist: clear the bedside surface, prepare tomorrow, choose a calmer cue. Tell us your preference in a future opted-in survey; no live links in this draft. LOCAL DRAFT — NOT SENT.

data.subject: Keep the useful part
data.body: Day 7: One final reminder to keep whichever step works for you. Browse the local product comparison only if relevant. In a real email, honor consent, unsubscribe and suppression rules. LOCAL DRAFT — NOT SENT.

data.title: Winback sequence / holdout design
data.hypothesis: Useful routine content may re-engage eligible established customers. Declining cohort purchases can reflect seasonality or synthetic mix; do not assume email is the cause.
data.variants: Draft A: checklist-first opening. Draft B: preference question. Randomized eligible recipients plus 10% holdout. Primary measure: 14-day reorder rate; guardrails: unsubscribes and complaints. No sending or list upload authorized.
